purpose: isolate endpoint photometric/geometry contribution to cadence-dependent event inflation; exact recorded HDR/pose rows only
supersedes_pilot: 20261019b exploratory pass; this version filters archived reference raw events to the same selected time interval before count and seam summaries
direct_state_sampling: every exact state_control_trace row in the selected time window; no synthetic or interpolated states

paths.sparse_ours: 100 Hz exact HDR endpoint renders passed through the existing frozen physics reconstruction plugin
paths.dense_ours: exact HDR direct renders of all available logged states passed sequentially through the same DVS response without geometric interpolation; irregular sample intervals are measured and reported
paths.common_reference: the already archived 2 kHz Direct-HDR raw event stream for the same episode and query; archived preprocessing uses log(luminance + 1e-6), while new physical_log paths use log(max(luminance, 1e-6)); threshold/noise settings match, with only this near-black floor convention differing
paths.terminal_exact_candidate: diagnostic-only: replace each interval final reconstructed frame with its exact endpoint luminance; preserve all intermediate reconstructed frames and frozen simulator core

models.shared_input: same causal five-bin event tensor; checkpoints receive events only

boundaries.physics: immutable trace from the 0.5 ms physics rollout, but state rows are not stored at every physics step; render only exact rows present, with no new rollout or synthetic state
boundaries.geometry_gt: used by Ours generation and post-inference scoring only; not passed to models
boundaries.dense_render: exact logged states rendered offline; direct renderer reference for image/event simulation, not physical event-camera ground truth
boundaries.ranking: not a method ranking; previously inspected episodes are development diagnostics only
